Attached: 1 image

Your home PCs and Macs, in a browser tab on your own server.

Just Dashboard's Remote Desktop reaches Windows, Mac and Linux machines over Tailscale, unattended, with clipboard and file transfer, plus a Stream mode that plays the screen as 60 fps video via Sunshine. Nothing is opened to the internet.

https://just-dashboard.com

#selfhosted #homelab #tailscale #remotedesktop

(Written with AI assistance.)
